**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4466-null-group-bucket`.

**Ruling (delegated authority; open veto window)**: render null-keyed groups under an explicit bucket label — the card's own case 3 rules out silent dropping (the chart understates its own data while the axis proves it was there), and the bucket answer SUBSUMES the all-null case: one `(None)`-style bar is more honest than an empty state when the server returned 50 real events. This also resolves the two-answers disagreement the card names: empty result set → the existing designed empty state; non-empty result → bars, always, null bucket included. One renderer, one answer for each question.

1. **Home by measurement**: the mapping belongs in the shared series layer — `packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts`'s single-dimension branch (the located cause), where the #4404 label-map family (`deriveDimensionLabelMaps` / `dimensionOptionTranslator`) already owns category-label resolution. Map the null/undefined category to the bucket label THERE so every consumer (dashboard widgets, standalone ObjectChart) gets the same answer — do not patch it in the recharts wrapper per-chart.
2. **The label goes through the i18n channel** per convention (defaults-map rows, the live #4409 gate) — an en `(None)` / zh `(未指定)`-class label; measure what sibling "unlabeled bucket" conventions exist before inventing wording.
3. Check `hasNoCategoryKey` in `AdvancedChartImpl` still means what it says post-fix (key absent vs value null are now both handled — the former by it, the latter by the bucket).

**Red-first (the card's own three cases)**: partial case is the sharpest — rows `[{user_id:null,count:51},{user_id:'Dev Admin',count:2}]` pre-fix renders ONE bar (dominant group silently dropped), post-fix TWO bars with the null bucket labeled and counted; all-null case pre-fix axes-without-marks, post-fix one labeled bar. Must-not-change: non-null groups render identically; the genuine empty-result state stays the designed empty state (green both sides).

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/core` + patch `@object-ui/plugin-charts` (renders strictly more of the data already fetched); `.d.ts`-checked both ways, minor only if a public surface grows. Never major.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts` + `packages/plugin-charts/**` (renderer semantics + tests) + i18n defaults-map rows + changesets. ⛔ NOT: plugin-dashboard (in-flight #4432 — your fix reaches its widgets through core, no dashboard file edits), plugin-calendar (#4453), console/** (#4474), the DOM-leak ledger. Disjoint from in-flight #4408 (list error state) — if its measured surface unexpectedly names chart files, the LATER dispatch yields; check its claim comment before editing.
